schema_version: 1
source_of_truth: docs/storage-and-delivery.md
event_types: [session_start, session_end, key_press, shortcut, copy, paste, cursor_move, selection_change, typing_stats, lesson_started, lesson_opened, lesson_completed, question_asked, text_selected, task_started, task_attempted, task_completed, code_changed, code_executed, compiler_error, test_failed, test_passed, hint_requested, student_idle, student_stuck, teacher_intervened]
required_dimensions: [user_id, role, session_id, course_id, lesson_id, task_id, platform, editor_mode, event_type]
payload: arbitrary_json_object_stored_as_string
interesting_activity:
  subject: learning.activity.interesting
  stream: LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS
  stable_event_id_required_for: [student_stuck, student_idle, compiler_error, test_failed, test_passed]
  ownership: bounded observation only; Teacher decides whether to intervene and Student owns mastery
  delivery: best effort after process-memory telemetry acceptance
delivery:
  acceptance: enqueued_in_process_memory
  durability_at_ack: false
  batch_trigger: configured_size_or_interval
  flush_retry: none
  flush_error: logged_then_batch_discarded
  batch_validation: sequential_and_may_partially_enqueue_before_error
legacy:
  course_version_id_request_field: not_supported
  course_version_id_storage_value: zero_uuid
